metadata.description: Live-captured POST /api/mdm/profiles/uploadcertificate against UEM 26.2.0.0, 2026-08-05, org group 138883 (sdktest). Request body was a genuinely valid self-signed PKCS#12 certificate (openssl req -x509 + pkcs12 -export, RSA 2048), base64-encoded, with Password set -- server-side X.509/PKCS12 parsing was exercised for real, not bypassed. KNOWN LIMITATION: no DELETE endpoint exists anywhere in the mdm v1-v4 swagger surface for a standalone uploaded certificate (the only certificate-adjacent DELETE, /profiles/certificatemap/{mappingID}, deletes a profile-to-certificate mapping, not the certificate resource) -- the real certificate created during this capture could not be cleaned up via the API. Accepted as a known, low-risk exception (self-signed test cert on a dedicated sdktest org group whose explicit purpose covers this).
